name: octaweave_update_card
description: Edit, move, or complete a card. Moving between columns is {column: 'Done'}; completing is {completed: true}. POSITION IS RELATIVE, NEVER AN INDEX: `after` absent means do not move, `after` null means move to the top of the column, and `after` set to a card id drops it directly below that card. `base_version` is checked for title/body edits only, so a move never conflicts with an edit — but pass it whenever you change text.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

base_version.description: The card's `version`; required when changing title or body.

column.description: Move to this column id or name.

after.description: Reposition: null = top of the column, a card id = directly below it. Omit to leave in place.

completed.description: true completes the card and stamps completed_at; false reopens it.
